aboutGame.title: What is Otterly Lost?
paragraphs: Otterly Lost is a cozy single-player adventure from Soulworks Interactive in which you play as Otto, a curious river otter trying to find his way back to his family raft. The journey is built around physics-driven swimming: you paddle downstream, dive beneath fallen logs, ride eddies, and slide down muddy banks instead of fighting through a combat system.

There are no health bars, timers, or game-over screens. If a current sweeps you off course, the river gently resets you to a calm pool nearby so you can try again at your own pace. Along the way you forage for shoreberries, crack open clams, collect river shells and pet rocks, befriend woodland animals, and build cozy dens across the Whispering Shallows, the Timber Dam, the Roaring Rapids, and the Sunken Estuary.

modules.name: Otterly Lost Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the core survival loop before you head downstream: paddling and diving, stamina and breath control, foraging for food, and building your first safe den.

highlights.detail: Start with the tutorial and learn surface paddling before you fight any current.
Watch your Stamina, Hunger, and Body Temperature while swimming and diving.
Drift downstream to save stamina, and rest in river eddies to refill your breath.
Forage clams, shellfish, and river weeds in shallow water before attempting deep dives.
Build a den on high, dry ground near calm water so you can sleep and save progress.
Avoid shoreline predators and current traps by reading white water early.

modules.name: Otterly Lost Walkthrough
modules.description: A complete chapter-by-chapter route through the story, covering the important quests, environmental puzzles, and hidden shortcuts that keep Otto moving toward home.

highlights.detail: Chapter 1: Whispering Shallows - learn the controls, forage your first food, and meet your first companions.
Chapter 2: The Timber Dam and Wetland Maze - solve log dams and sluice-gate buoyancy puzzles.
Chapter 3: Roaring Rapids and Canyon Flumes - ride fast currents and clear boulder hazards.
Chapter 4: Sunken Estuary and the Raft Reunion - finish the journey and reunite the raft.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Otterly Lost.

items.question: What is Otterly Lost?
items.answer: Otterly Lost is a cozy single-player adventure from Soulworks Interactive. You play as Otto, a river otter who gets separated from his family raft and must swim, dive, and forage his way home through four connected river regions.

items.question: Is Otterly Lost a combat game?
items.answer: No. Otterly Lost has no combat, health bars, or permanent fail states. The challenge comes from reading currents, timing dives, and solving buoyancy and sluice-gate puzzles. If a current sweeps you off course, the river resets you to a calm pool nearby.

items.question: Can you play Otterly Lost in co-op?
items.answer: Yes. Otterly Lost supports co-op river sessions where players hold paws to form a raft, share foraging runs, and split up for lever and sluice puzzles. The story campaign itself is designed as a focused single-player expedition.

items.question: What are the main collectibles in Otterly Lost?
items.answer: The main collectibles in Otterly Lost are river shells, pet rocks, shoreberries, and hidden trinkets. Shells act as currency, pet rocks solve pressure-plate puzzles, shoreberries restore stamina, and trinkets unlock den upgrades.

items.question: How long does Otterly Lost take to finish?
items.answer: A relaxed first playthrough of Otterly Lost usually takes around 3 to 5 hours. Following a walkthrough can cut that to roughly 2 hours, while a full 100% collectible run typically spans about 6 hours.

items.question: Where can I play Otterly Lost?
items.answer: Otterly Lost is available on Steam for PC, with a free demo covering the Chapter 1 tutorial. It runs well on the Steam Deck, and DRM-free storefronts such as GOG and itch.io are also good options for offline play.
